rule: GAID behaviour lives in geo/, server/src/geo/ and web/src/geo/. An edit to an upstream file is a maintained seam: list it here with its owner before making it, keep it narrow, and record conflicts in docs/upstream-sync.md. Shared glue, contracts, locale aggregators and dependency locks have one owner at a time; append-only entries are allowed where noted.

seams.responsibility: --production flag (web build stamp, next start), product name and issues URL from env, KADY_ENV_FILE as the managed env file; development behaviour unchanged
Load KADY_ENV_FILE before the repository env files
Persist Settings keys to KADY_ENV_FILE when set
Catalogue extra sources filtered by geo/distribution.json excludedSources; later distribution defaults go to gaid-runtime
Release check against the distribution repository and tag prefix
App version and release URL from geo/distribution.json
gaid-fork-base changed only the update link target (NEXT_PUBLIC_RELEASES_URL); branding and copy belong to gaid-korean-workspace
GAID tag-driven draft release (geo-v<version>) instead of upstream's push-to-main v<server version> release
Upstream CI kept as is; GAID checks run from .github/workflows/gaid-checks.yml and scripts/check
Upstream CI steps plus geo checks; later packages append their own steps
Release-bundle staging and task-exposure adapter; skills-sync.ts stays the only installer into live skill directories
Seed selected geo environments and concise project instructions
Register geo inspection/context extensions and tools (extensionFactories, customTools)
Import the small geo-result reference schema

Format-aware dispatch; gaid-runtime publishes the geo viewer interface; gaid-well-tables and gaid-maps may append their own entries (append-only lines); gaid-korean-workspace owns any non-additive change
Layout, theme, metadata and brand assets (WP00 tokens, Korean-first copy in web/src/geo/locales/)

seams.path: server/package.json, server/package-lock.json, web/package.json, web/package-lock.json, server/src/helpers/pyproject.toml, server/src/helpers/uv.lock
seams.responsibility: Dependency locks: one package at a time adds dependencies; the owner moves to the package that needs a change and back after its merge

notTouched: Subagent supervision, notebook and provenance persistence, cost ledger and billing
